description: Mary Sattler Peltola, Yup'ik; raised in Bethel and Anchorage.
Served ten years in the state House as a Democrat, representing the 39th district (1999-2003) and the 38th (2003-2009).
Defeated Sarah Palin in the ranked-choice special election; sworn in September 2022.
First Alaska Native woman in Congress; served one full term plus the partial 117th Congress.
Her husband was killed in a small-plane crash in September 2023.

role_or_event: Lost re-election to Nick Begich III
description: Lost by about 2.5 points after ranked-choice transfers.
Joined the law and lobbying firm; barred from lobbying Congress for a year after leaving office.
Announced a challenge to Sen. Dan S. Sullivan.
144,302 votes (50.12%); outright first-round majority; race called Nov. 17.
